name: cleanliness
description: How clean the place itself was: dirt, dust, stains, hair, bathroom and kitchen hygiene, and smells coming from the flat (drains, mould, stale smoke). Not smells or smoke from neighbours or the street.

name: location
description: The neighbourhood and getting around: distance to sights, transport, shops, safety of the area.

name: host communication
description: How the host responded and helped: speed of replies, friendliness, problem solving.

name: check-in
description: Arrival and departure: key handover, instructions, self check-in, waiting, late arrival.

name: noise
description: Sound from the street, neighbours, bars, trams or thin walls, and whether guests could sleep.

name: comfort and beds
description: Beds, pillows, sofa, temperature, heating or air conditioning, general comfort.

name: kitchen and amenities
description: Equipment provided: kitchen, washing machine, towels, toiletries, coffee, TV.

name: value for money
description: Whether the stay felt worth its price, mentions of price, fees or deposits.

name: accuracy vs listing
description: Whether the place matched the photos and description: size, view, missing or extra features.

name: wi-fi and work
description: Internet speed and reliability, desk or space for working remotely.
